title: Cost Ops Toolkit: Batching, Caching, and Quantization Playbook
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a prescriptive, engineering-facing Cost Ops Toolkit that consolidates recommended batching, KV/prefix caching, and quantization settings into a repeatable playbook for teams running RL/production workloads. The playbook will include: concrete configuration templates for Redwood Dedicated/Private, a canary rollout plan, expected unit-econ improvements for typical workloads (chat, long-form generation, embeddings), and simple diagnostic checks to detect regressions in quality or latency. This ticket tracks the PM-level scope: PRD finalization, cross-team alignment, OKRs, and rollout communication. Engineering tickets under this parent will implement templates, console UI affordances, and CI checks. Design will provide minimal UX for the console presets and rollout flow.
acceptance_criteria: PRD approved by Eng, Design, and Reliability
Playbook contains 3 validated templates (small-chat, long-seq-generation, embedding-batch) with expected token-cost reduction estimates
Canary rollout plan documented with rollback triggers and SLO guardrails
Console presets implemented as beta in staging and feature-flagged for a subset of customers
Automated tests/checks added to catch quality regressions for the provided templates
metrics: OKR: Reduce average hosted per-token cost by 18% for PLG workloads by 2026-Q2
Secondary metric: p95 latency change (should not exceed +12ms from baseline for small-chat template)
Safety metric: number of quality-regression alerts triggered by eval suite per release (target: 0 false negatives)
